page_note: Page 246 is severely damaged (90.9%) but structurally clear. Seg 11 is a textbook dialogue-frame attribution. Segs 12-32 (heavily damaged) constitute substrate cosmological teaching about creature reproduction modalities, three types/natures, and the Ambassador (Third Messenger). Editorial fatigue score is negative (-2.87), and apostolic_dialogue vocabulary collapses in the second half — the Q&A frame opens the new chapter but the teaching itself is substrate. The three-fold enumeration of reproductive modalities is classic correspondential systematics.
